capabilities: Update a single key-value frontmatter field
Insert or remove items in key-array frontmatter fields
Bulk update multiple frontmatter fields at once
Create frontmatter with the selected pair when none exists
extras: Commands only work in edit mode; the plugin is installed by manually copying files into the plugins folder; key-object structures are listed as undecided future work.
intentEvidence: Keey you away from directly operating yaml front matter, so you won't make mistake.
motivation: The author wants to keep users 'away from directly operating yaml front matter, so you won't make mistake.'
problem: Editing YAML frontmatter directly is error-prone, and Obsidian offers no guided commands to change individual field values.
summary: Frontmatter editor that updates YAML properties through commands instead of typing YAML by hand.
